per_panel_scene_hints.01: No host. Owl on night watch beside a phone showing 00:47, a warm night lamp, a voice-note waveform on the screen. Huge white hook. Scene, not a mechanic title.
per_panel_scene_hints.02: No host. Type-heavy. Loyal dog on duty at a dark daytime phone / empty chat. Metaphor: loyalty to his hours, not her day.
per_panel_scene_hints.03: No host. Type-heavy. Dog with broken sleep near a 01:12 clock. Metaphor: she gives the night to his window.
per_panel_scene_hints.04: No host. Owl looking through a night window (glass, lamp, city dark) — not an altar. Metaphor: midnight is hours without witnesses.
per_panel_scene_hints.05: No host. Cat + three-row decoder Говорит / Слышишь / Есть. Metaphor: the cat senses the swap.
per_panel_scene_hints.06: No host. Cat + numbered 1-2-3 daylight checks. Metaphor: three daylight doors, not one night gate.
per_panel_scene_hints.07: No host. Dog standing up from the dark screen, leaving the midnight watch. Three questions stacked.
per_panel_scene_hints.08: No host. Owl as quiet witness. One screenshot rule. Light tarot card OK if it does not cover the headline.
per_panel_scene_hints.09: No host. Owl holds or sits beside the huge magenta handwritten ПОЛНОЧЬ (RU) / MIDNIGHT (EN). Phone/app object. Body: аудиоразбор в моём приложении / Audio reading in the app. No bot.

thumbnail_test: Slide 01 must read at ~200px: 00:47 голосовое vs 14:20 нет галочек, plus owl + phone/lamp. If the hook needs zoom, fail. Fail if a woman is on the cover.
save_test: Slides 05 (Говорит / Слышишь / Есть), 06 (3 дневные проверки), 07 (3 вопроса), 08 (ночь без дня — окно) are the bookmark cards.
